notes: Complete selected UTF-8 text files are collected; no line excerpts or truncation.
Cluster paths, current username/host and recognized node names are replaced with placeholders.
Existing project files are not modified. Only this new audit directory, archive and scheduler logs are written.
Binary files, symlinks, other formats and oversized files are skipped and listed in the manifest.
Original and collected checksums differ when sanitization changes bytes. Source checksums in copied reports refer to original files, not sanitized copies.
Collection status describes copying only. It does not validate scientific results or analysis completion.
Review collected content before sharing for sensitive material beyond paths.
Any file reported as changed during reading should be recollected when its writer finishes.
